name: What types of metal roofing materials are available for residential properties?

mainEntity.name: What types of metal roofing materials are available for residential properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common residential metal roofing materials include steel, aluminum, copper, and zinc. Steel is often galvanized or galvalume for durability and comes in various gauges and finishes. Aluminum is lighter, corrosion-resistant, and suitable for coastal areas, while copper offers a distinct aesthetic and develops a patina over time. Zinc is highly durable and self-healing. When selecting, consider the climate and desired aesthetic; for example, aluminum can be a good choice for corrosion resistance in areas like Addison.
acceptedAnswer.description: Residential metal roofing options include steel, aluminum, copper, and zinc, each offering different aesthetics, durability, and corrosion resistance.
